tutorial.place: Select an immune cell, then place it on a glowing defense node.
tutorial.atp: ATP powers deployment. Defeat pathogens or use Energy Cells to gain more.
tutorial.infection: Infection weakens a node. B-Cells can cleanse it.
tutorial.fever: When Fever is ready, activate it for a short defensive boost.
medical.notice: Immune War is a fictional strategy game, not medical advice.
